Commentary.Commentary: Right then, that is it from this one-sided affair. India opens their account in the Super Eights stage while Afghanistan have it all to do in their next two games. However, the action does not stop here as we have a big clash coming up between Australia and Bangladesh on 21st June, Friday. That match will begin at 6 am (12.30 am GMT), but as you know, you can always join us early for all the build-up. Until then, cheers and goodbye!

Rohit Sharma, the victorious skipper of India starts by saying that over the last couple of years, they have come to the West Indies and have played a few T20Is and are familiar with the conditions. Adds that 180 was a tremendous effort by the batters and then they knew they had a class bowling lineup. Mentions that it is crucial that the likes of Surya and Hardik come to form and every individual has to do their job and applauds that partnership. On Jasprit Bumrah, says that everyone knows he is class and it is about using him smartly and Bumrah himself takes the responsibility to achieve that. On the extra spinner, he says that nothing is concrete with the playing XI and it also depends on the opposition and if the next venue offers something for the seamers, they will be open to bringing back the extra seamer.

Rashid Khan, the captain of Afghanistan says that they knew, they would be chasing in excess of 160 but they could have been smarter with their executions. Adds that his bowling is coming off well and he is hitting the right areas, but the result matters the most. Mentions that they have enjoyed their cricket everywhere but the most important thing is the mindset. Ends by saying that they will play according to the conditions after assessing if it is a batting or bowling track.

Suryakumar Yadav is the PLAYER OF THE MATCH for his breezy half-century. He says that there's a lot of hard work and practice that goes into his play. Adds that he is really happy to get the win and is happy to be the first Indian batter to get the player of the match as well in this tournament. On Rashid Khan, he says that Rashid is very difficult to pick but you have to take him on and he is happy to have had the better of him in this game. Mentions that there is a game plan from the start but he plays according to the game situation and had a chat with Hardik Pandya about keeping their foot on the pedal as it would get hard to hit the ball in the death overs due to the reverse swing and the slower deliveries.
Presentation Time...

Earlier in the game, India posted a big total on the board courtesy of a fine half-century from SKY along with crucial contributions from Rishabh Pant, Hardik Pandya, and Axar Patel. Afghanistan were a bit off in this game with the ball and it was their skipper, Rashid Khan who was the pick of the bowler with three wickets. Fazalhaq Farooqi also got three, while Naveen-ul-Haq chipped in with one. While chasing, the Afghans came out with intent, but they kept on losing wickets in clusters that did not help them at all as they faced back-to-back defeats in this World Cup.

India, on the other hand, after a shaky first over, were all over the Afghans throughout the game. Jasprit Bumrah got rid of Rahmanullah Gurbaz in the second over. Axar followed it up by dismissing Ibrahim Zadran, while it was Bumrah again who sent Hazratullah Zazai back to the hut. They allowed a partnership to build in the middle overs but after the drinks break, it was all India once again. Kuldeep Yadav and Ravindra Jadeja sent back both the set batters, and Afghanistan could not really recover from that. Bumrah and Kuldeep added one more to their tallies while Arshdeep Singh wrapped things up with three wickets in his last two overs.

Afghanistan needed a quick start, and Rahmanullah Gurbaz played a few lusty blows to put the pressure on Arshdeep. However, it all fell apart when he got out in the second over and his opening partner, Hazratullah Zazai followed suit, while Ibrahim Zadran also failed to make much of an impact After that, it was the pair of Gulbadin Naib and Azmatullah Omarzai who steadied the ship with a decent partnership, but the asking rate kept creeping up. They tried to up the ante, but both the set batters lost their wicket in quick succession, and they suffered a collapse afterward as no batter could stick around for much longer. In the end, they fell short by a big margin of 47 runs.

CLINICAL PERFORMANCE FROM INDIA! The bowlers were just too hot to handle for the Afghans here and the Men in Blue keeps their unbeaten streak in this World Cup intact. They were under a bit of pressure when they lost the two big guns early, but Suryakumar Yadav showed why he is the number-one ranked batter in this format, and then the entire bowling unit came to the party to register a convincing victory.

OUT! CAUGHT! That's it, Arshdeep Singh gets his third wicket and India bundles out Afghanistan on the final delivery. The Indian skipper makes no error and India win the game by 47 huge runs!

Commentary.Commentary: No ball! Uh, oh! A cardinal sin from Kuldeep Yadav on his very first delivery of the tournament. This is tossed up a bit full on middle and leg, Azmatullah Omarzai heaves it down to long on for one and Kuldeep has overstepped. Free Hit to follow.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 8.1: Kuldeep Yadav to Azmatullah Omarzai, No ball!

Commentary.Commentary: Another good piece of fielding in the deep, this time from Arshdeep Singh. On a length and around middle, Gulbadin Naib swats the ball across the line and to the right of deep mid-wicket where Arshdeep runs across and dives in before throwing the ball up to the other fielder and keeps it down to two.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 7.6: Axar Patel to Gulbadin Naib, 2 runs.

Commentary.Commentary: Dragged length on the stumps, played off the back foot and just to the bowler's right.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 7.5: Axar Patel to Gulbadin Naib, No run.

Commentary.Commentary: Excellent work in the deep eventually by Kuldeep Yadav but the batters do pick up three runs. Slightly short and wide of the off stump, Azmatullah Omarzai rocks back and cuts it late and well behind point. Kuldeep makes good ground to his left from deep point and dives across to make the stop. He then rolls over and lets the ball go just before his hand towel which he had tucked in behind hid back made contact with the rope.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 7.4: Axar Patel to Azmatullah Omarzai, 3 runs.

Commentary.Commentary: Slightly short and around off, Gulbadin Naib presses back and punches it with the full face of the bat to long off for one more.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 7.3: Axar Patel to Gulbadin Naib, 1 run.

Commentary.Commentary: Floated up around middle and angling in, Azmatullah Omarzai brings out the big heave and gets it wide of long on for just a single.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 7.2: Axar Patel to Azmatullah Omarzai, 1 run.

Commentary.Commentary: Bowled from wider on the crease and angled in quite a long way from outside off on a nagging length, Azmatullah Omarzai backs away and dabs it towards backward point.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 7.1: Axar Patel to Azmatullah Omarzai, No run.

Commentary.Commentary: Smart bowling and Hardik Pandya finishes the over with three dot balls. A slower bumper, well-directed around off stump, Gulbadin Naib bends his back and drops his hands to leave it alone.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 6.6: Hardik Pandya to Gulbadin Naib, No run.

Commentary.Commentary: Banged in short and wide of the off stump, this one doesn't get up high enough, Gulbadin Naib looks to fetch and pull but is well beaten.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 6.5: Hardik Pandya to Gulbadin Naib, No run.

Commentary.Commentary: Falls safely! Hardik Pandya brings out the surprise bumper and bowls it around off, angling it in. Gulbadin Naib swivels and looks to pull but is hurried on and the ball goes off the gloves and off the body lobbing up well in front of point.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 6.4: Hardik Pandya to Gulbadin Naib, No run.

Commentary.Commentary: Too high! Just short of a good length and this one nips back in from middle, Gulbadin Naib plays around the ball and gets hit quite high on the pads as the ball rolls behind point.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 6.3: Hardik Pandya to Gulbadin Naib, No run.

Commentary.Commentary: Pitched up outside the line of off stump, Azmatullah Omarzai reaches out and drives it on the up to sweeper cover for a single.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 6.2: Hardik Pandya to Azmatullah Omarzai, 1 run.

Commentary.Commentary: FOUR! A real 'hit-me' ball from Hardik Pandya first up. A long half volley outside the off stump, Azmatullah Omarzai waits well and smashes the drive through covers and picks up a boundary.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 6.1: Hardik Pandya to Azmatullah Omarzai, Four!

Commentary.Commentary: SIX! Gulbadin Naib chances his arm and ends the Powerplay with a biggie. Dragged a bit short and angled into the batter, Naib rocks back and uses those big guns to muscle it over cow corner for a six.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 5.6: Axar Patel to Gulbadin Naib, Six!

Commentary.Commentary: Nice and full on the off stump, driven on the up and firmly to long off for one more.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 5.5: Axar Patel to Azmatullah Omarzai, 1 run.

Commentary.Commentary: That's gone through and Axar Patel concedes his first run of the game. Floated up a bit on middle stump, Gulbadin Naib pushes it straight back and Patel fails to gather it and it roll down to long off for a single.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 5.4: Axar Patel to Gulbadin Naib, 1 run.

Commentary.Commentary: Slightly shorter and slower around off stump, Gulbadin Naib stays back and pushes it away in front of point.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 5.3: Axar Patel to Gulbadin Naib, No run.

Commentary.Commentary: A bit flatter and angled into the stumps, Gulbadin Naib stays back and manages to push it back to the bowler.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 5.2: Axar Patel to Gulbadin Naib, No run.

Commentary.Commentary: Swing and a miss! Tossed up a bit fuller and wider of the off stump, going straight on, Gulbadin Naib does down to play the slog sweep but misses it completely.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 5.1: Axar Patel to Gulbadin Naib, No run.

Commentary.Commentary: Fullish and on middle, Azmatullah Omarzai fends it as the ball rolls towards mid on, there is a bit of mix-up between the batters and the throw comes in at the batter's end but no harm is done.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 4.6: Jasprit Bumrah to Azmatullah Omarzai, No run.

Commentary.Commentary: Pace-off again, on a length and on off, Azmatullah Omarzai guides it towards point.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 4.5: Jasprit Bumrah to Azmatullah Omarzai, No run.

Commentary.Commentary: FOUR! A bit streaky! Jasprit Bumrah bowls a good yorker here, on off, angling in, Azmatullah Omarzai just gets his bat down in time and squeezes it between the keeper and first slip for a boundary.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 4.4: Jasprit Bumrah to Azmatullah Omarzai, Four!

Commentary.Commentary: Good-length and just outside off, Azmatullah Omarzai leaves it alone.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 4.3: Jasprit Bumrah to Azmatullah Omarzai, No run.

Commentary.Commentary: Pitched up and on middle, Azmatullah Omarzai blocks it out on the pitch.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 4.2: Jasprit Bumrah to Azmatullah Omarzai, No run.

Commentary.Commentary: Azmatullah Omarzai walks in with Afghanistan in a spot of bother.

OUT! IN THE AIR AND GONE! Jasprit Bumrah gets his second and Afghanistan are in huge trouble now. This one is a slower delivery as Bumrah rolls his fingers on it, lands this on a good length, on middle, Hazratullah Zazai looks to flick it away but closes the face of the bat very early, the ball loops off the leading edge towards point where Ravindra Jadeja takes a dolly.
Commentary.Howout: c Ravindra Jadeja b Jasprit Bumrah
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 4.1: Jasprit Bumrah to Hazratullah Zazai, OUT! c Ravindra Jadeja b Jasprit Bumrah.

Commentary.Commentary: Slows it up, short and on middle, turns away, Gulbadin Naib looks to work it away but gets an outside edge along the ground to short third. A wicket-maiden to start from Axar Patel.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 3.6: Axar Patel to Gulbadin Naib, No run.

Commentary.Commentary: Darts this one on middle, Gulbadin Naib pushes it back to the bowler.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 3.5: Axar Patel to Gulbadin Naib, No run.

Commentary.Commentary: Gulbadin Naib is the new batter in.

OUT! STRAIGHT TO THE FIELDER! Axar Patel strikes in his first over as well! He sees the batter back away and fires this one, full and around middle, Ibrahim Zadran tries to loft it over extra covers, but fails to get the elevation and hits it flat and straight to Rohit Sharma who takes a sharp catch. Afghanistan loses both their openers now!
Commentary.Howout: c Rohit Sharma b Axar Patel
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 3.4: Axar Patel to Ibrahim Zadran, OUT! c Rohit Sharma b Axar Patel.

Commentary.Commentary: Quicker, short and on middle, goes with the arm, Ibrahim Zadran gets hurried and pushes it down the pitch.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 3.3: Axar Patel to Ibrahim Zadran, No run.

Commentary.Commentary: Floated, full and on middle, Ibrahim Zadran knocks it to the left of the bowler.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 3.2: Axar Patel to Ibrahim Zadran, No run.

Commentary.Commentary: Axar Patel starts with a flatter delivery, angling into the pads, Ibrahim Zadran tucks it to short mid-wicket.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 3.1: Axar Patel to Ibrahim Zadran, No run.

Commentary.Commentary: On a length and on off, Ibrahim Zadran pushes it through covers for one more. End of an eventful over!
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 2.6: Arshdeep Singh to Ibrahim Zadran, 1 run.

Commentary.Commentary: A slower one, full and on off, Hazratullah Zazai taps it to the off side for one.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 2.5: Arshdeep Singh to Hazratullah Zazai, 1 run.

Commentary.Commentary: DROPPED! Of all people, it is Virat Kohli who puts it down! Short of a length and outside off, Ibrahim Zadran punches it but fails to keep it down, the ball flies towards point where Kohli leaps up, gets both hands on it but spills it out. No one in the field can believe it, neither can we. A single is taken and Zadran gets a life here! The timing of the jump from Kohli was all wrong too.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 2.4: Arshdeep Singh to Ibrahim Zadran, 1 run.

Commentary.Commentary: FOUR! Excellent shot! Back of a length and just around off, but that is enough for Ibrahim Zadran to free his arms and crunch it behind point for a boundary.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 2.3: Arshdeep Singh to Ibrahim Zadran, Four!

Commentary.Commentary: Fuller and on off, Hazratullah Zazai knocks it towards long off for a run.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 2.2: Arshdeep Singh to Hazratullah Zazai, 1 run.

Commentary.Commentary: Pitched up and around off, Ibrahim Zadran pushes it through covers for a single. They look for two but decide against it as it is Ravindra Jadeja who is the fielder there.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 2.1: Arshdeep Singh to Ibrahim Zadran, 1 run.

Commentary.Commentary: Length again and on off, keeps a bit low, Hazratullah Zazai keeps it out to the off side. Just one run and a big wicket from the over!
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 1.6: Jasprit Bumrah to Hazratullah Zazai, No run.

Commentary.Commentary: On a length and on off, Ibrahim Zadran runs it down to third man for a single.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 1.5: Jasprit Bumrah to Ibrahim Zadran, 1 run.

Commentary.Commentary: Hard length and around off, shaping in sharply, Ibrahim Zadran looks to defend but gets beaten on the inside edge.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 1.4: Jasprit Bumrah to Ibrahim Zadran, No run.

Commentary.Commentary: Back of a length and on off, Ibrahim Zadran dabs it down to cover-point.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 1.3: Jasprit Bumrah to Ibrahim Zadran, No run.

Commentary.Commentary: Ibrahim Zadran walks in at number 3.

OUT! CAUGHT BEHIND! Who else, it is that man Jasprit Bumrah once again! He sees the batter back away and bowls this a touch fuller, but well outside off and slower too, Rahmanullah Gurbaz still tries to reach for it, and throws his bat it. However, he only manages to toe-end it behind where Rishabh Pant makes no mistake. Early blow for Afghanistan!
Commentary.Howout: c Rishabh Pant b Jasprit Bumrah
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 1.2: Jasprit Bumrah to Rahmanullah Gurbaz, OUT! c Rishabh Pant b Jasprit Bumrah.

Commentary.Commentary: Jasprit Bumrah begins with a good-length delivery, on off, Rahmanullah Gurbaz pats it down to covers.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 1.1: Jasprit Bumrah to Rahmanullah Gurbaz, No run.

Commentary.Commentary: Jasprit Bumrah to operate from the other end.

Uppish but safe! Short of a length and around off, Rahmanullah Gurbaz trise to ramp it away but gets a top edge, the ball flies and lands just wide of the diving Jasprit Bumrah at short third. They cross. 13 runs off the first over then!
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 0.6: Arshdeep Singh to Rahmanullah Gurbaz, 1 run.

Commentary.Commentary: SIX! BANG! That is some shot from Rahmanullah Gurbaz! Arshdeep Singh bangs this into the pitch, on middle, Rahmanullah Gurbaz skips down the track once again, gets on top of the bounce and hammers it over the deep mid-wicket fence for a biggie.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 0.5: Arshdeep Singh to Rahmanullah Gurbaz, Six!

Commentary.Commentary: BEAUTY! Hits the perfect length, on the fifth stump line, nips away a shy bit, Rahmanullah Gurbaz stays in his crease to push at it but gets beaten on the outside edge.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 0.4: Arshdeep Singh to Rahmanullah Gurbaz, No run.

Commentary.Commentary: Arshdeep Singh bangs in a bouncer this time, but it goes over the head of the batter, Rahmanullah Gurbaz sways away from it. Wided.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 0.4: Arshdeep Singh to Rahmanullah Gurbaz, Wide!

Commentary.Commentary: Back of a length, just outside off, gets it shape away once again, Rahmanullah Gurbaz charges down the track but is nowhere near the ball.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 0.3: Arshdeep Singh to Rahmanullah Gurbaz, No run.

Commentary.Commentary: Good-length delivery, in that channel outside off, shaping away, Rahmanullah Gurbaz withdraws his bat at the last moment.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 0.2: Arshdeep Singh to Rahmanullah Gurbaz, No run.

Commentary.Commentary: FOUR! Shot of intent! Arshdeep Singh goes fuller this time, on middle, no movement, Rahmanullah Gurbaz comes down the track, presents the full face of he bat, and lofts it over the bowler's head for the first boundary of the chase.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 0.1: Arshdeep Singh to Rahmanullah Gurbaz, Four!

Commentary.Commentary: Afghanistan get underway with extras! Arshdeep Singh starts with a hard-length delivery but way, way outside off, Rahmanullah Gurbaz leaves it alone. It is called a wide.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 0.1: Arshdeep Singh to Rahmanullah Gurbaz, Wide!
